crossRefs.note: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
“To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and…
The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…
Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak anything evil against the God of…
to him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:
“Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven…
Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by…

translations.web: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
translations.bsb: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
translations.kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
translations.asv: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither are there any works like unto thy works.
